novelty_flags.label: oeq:canonical-gradient and related_work
novelty_flags.one_line: The core cites TestaKennedyReimherr2025 Proposition 2.8, but arXiv v1 labels its semiparametric efficiency result Proposition 2.7.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: oeq:canonical-gradient; thm:one-step-attainment
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: Full observed-data canonical-gradient exhaustion is an open load-bearing step, not established by the finite marginal-score projection.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: Semiparametric-efficiency and attaining-estimator claims are conditional on an affirmative resolution of the pattern-score adjoint question.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: thm:one-step-attainment; thm:multiplier-bands
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: Inference is confined to the stated fixed-rank, positive-variance, and explicit nuisance-rate regime.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: Root-n attainment and multiplier coverage are claimed only under the fixed-rank projection regime, not uniformly near rank changes or zero gain.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: thm:bellego-embedding
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The Bellégo equation crosswalk is conditioned on the corrected January 2025 author copy because version-of-record equation text was not inspected.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: The strict tightening is relative to the explicitly crosswalked author-copy all-supported-link system pending version-of-record source verification.

source_verification_receipts.version: corrected author copy, arXiv v4, 31 January 2025
source_verification_receipts.locator: Abstract; Section 2.2 and Theorem 1 in the accessible HTML rendering
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The author copy studies chained DiD for incomplete panels, aggregates short-term effects, and allows general missing-data patterns and sample selection on observables; it is corroborative rather than a version-of-record equation receipt.
The paper derives observable sequential conditional-moment restrictions and semiparametric efficient influence functions for short-panel DiD/event-study parameters under parallel trends.
The v1 efficiency proposition is numbered Proposition 2.7 and gives efficient observed-data influence functions under its two missingness assumptions; it is not Proposition 2.8.

Resolve the pattern-score adjoint OEQ, then establish whether the quotient projection is the full canonical gradient rather than merely a finite marginal-score optimum.
